title: Supplementary materials for: Urban planning leaves an audible legacy in a megacity’s bird soundscape
description: Accompanying materials for Urban planning leaves an audible legacy in a megacity’s bird soundscape. Includes supplementary methods, tables and figures, R and Stan code, and aggregate summary data. The repository documents the required model inputs and the current scope of the public implementation. Raw recordings, model-ready station-level inputs and exact coordinates are not included.
